cohort: The study included 50 pregnant women experiencing vaginal bleeding in their first trimester.
finding: First trimester vaginal bleeding was identified as a predictive factor for various mother and infant consequences of pregnancy, including obstetric complications like premature labor and placental abruption, and led to abortion in 20% of cases.
mod_finding: Among the pregnancy outcomes, 56% of the women delivered through normal vaginal delivery (NVD).
